# Saksoft Limited (SAKSOFT) — Research Brief

## Overview
Saksoft is a mid-cap Indian IT services company (\u20b91,767 Cr market cap) focused on digital transformation, data engineering, and application management. The stock has corrected ~44% from its 52-week high and now trades at attractive multiples.

## Q4 FY26 Financials (Mar 2026)
| Metric | Q4 FY26 | YoY Change |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| Revenue from ops | \u20b9256.2 Cr | +4% |
| Net profit | \u20b936 Cr | +20% |
| PAT margin | 14.4% | — |
| EBITDA margin | 18.2% | — |

Full-year FY26 revenue: **\u20b91,007 Cr** (+14% YoY).

## Valuation
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Share price (NSE) | \u20b9142.28 |
| P/E (TTM) | **13.6x** |
| Forward P/E | **4.0x** |
| P/B | 2.27x |
| EV/EBITDA | 8.6x |
| Dividend yield | ~0.7% |
| Price/ Sales | 1.75x |

## Key Fundamentals
- **ROE**: 19.1% — strong return on equity
- **Debt/Equity**: 0.06 (virtually debt-free)
- **Current ratio**: 2.17 (healthy liquidity)
- **Beta**: 0.36 (low volatility)
- **FCF**: \u20b985 Cr TTM
- **Promoter holding**: 72.5%

## Dividend
Total FY26: **\u20b91.00/share** (\u20b90.45 interim + \u20b90.55 final, subject to approval).

## The Bull Case
- Extremely cheap on forward P/E (\u20b94.0x) — the market is pricing a sharp earnings decline that may not materialise.
- Zero net debt, strong FCF generation.
- 44% off 52-week high offers a significant margin of safety.
- ROE > 19% at 13.6x trailing P/E is a classic Graham-style value setup.

## Risks / Data Gaps
- Revenue growth moderated to 4% in Q4 — management didn't provide explicit FY27 guidance.
- Revenue breakdown by geography/service line and client concentration data not available in reviewed filings.
- Recent management change (V.V.R. Babu ceased) — impact unclear.
